answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 43449 Country: Pakistan Title: purity Question: I am really ashamed to tell that once I went holy Makkah by public bus and with a wet trouser (wet due to urine) I sat on the seat helplessly. Now I am very much afraid that every next Haji or person who will sit on that seat, will get impure and I will be responsible for that. Kindly guide me if there is anything which I can do except repenting and asking Allah's forgiveness. Answer ID: 43449 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 225/225/M=1434) If the wetness was only on the upper part of the seat and the impurity did not absorb inside the seat and the wetness dried before someone else sat on the same seat after you left it, then his cloth did not become impure. It is also possible that the situation was the vice versa; hence you must do taubah and istighfar and seek forgiveness from Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
